text: 创业板指涨超3%，新易盛涨超15%，中际旭创涨超13%，算力硬件、短剧、游戏、机器人等方向涨幅居前，沪深京三市上涨个股超3800只。
text_en: The ChiNext Index rose over 3%, Eoptolink gained over 15%, and Zhongji Innolight rose over 13%. Computing hardware, short dramas, gaming, and robotics sectors led the gains, with more than 3,800 stocks advancing across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets.
